The watchdog's own post-3:40 PM verification and the Friday weekly Notion performance refresh at 5:00 PM ET are the only approved post-3:40 PM DCA-related exceptions.

run_classification_policy.summary: Every run_state artifact carries a run_classification block. Scheduled runs of the repaired live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b; artifact root stays under .../ce16ba6b for continuity) write under scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/ and update latest_scheduled_run.json; manual runs write under manual_runs/<timestamp>/ and never touch that pointer. Every scheduled 3:20 PM ET run_state MUST include BOTH run_classification.cron_id='10ce362c' AND run_classification.supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b'; placeholder/ambiguous ids like 'ce16ba6b_replacement' are forbidden. For continuity, downstream analytics accept a scheduled run as valid evidence when cron_id='10ce362c' OR supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b'. Downstream analytics validate scheduled state, exclude all manual order IDs and any run_origin='manual'/manual_run=true state, and never infer scheduled status from broker orders alone.

base_amount_policy.summary: The graded DCA base amount is exactly $3.00; every candidate dollar amount equals $3.00 x multiplier. Never infer, discover, or fall back to $50.00 or any broker/account default base amount. If the base-amount config is missing or unreadable, continue using $3.00 and record base_amount_source='hardcoded_user_confirmed_3_usd'.

execution_authorization_policy.summary: Scheduled live DCA tasks (morning 10:30, midday 12:30, afternoon 3:20) are explicitly pre-authorized to automatically place qualifying buy orders within caps. They MUST NOT request per-order confirmation and MUST NOT call Robinhood review_equity_order (which forces preview-plus-confirmation). A scheduled live task may call place_equity_order directly ONLY after every internal validation, signal, budget, spread, confidence, and top-up check passes.
execution_authorization_policy.manual_runs: Manual / ad hoc runs still use review_equity_order plus confirmation before submit.
execution_authorization_policy.order_constraints: Buy-only, regular-hours-only market orders. No sells, options, crypto, margin, account changes, or cancellations. No more than one strategy order per ticker per stream.

circuit_breakers.summary: Hard circuit breakers enforced on every scheduled live order. When any breaker trips, the order is skipped (never resized past a cap).
circuit_breakers.max_per_order_note: 5x (max ladder multiplier) * $3 base = $15. No single order may exceed $15.
circuit_breakers.budget_caps: Per-run/day/week caps follow the tiered $3-base budget policy in config/budgets.json (budget_tiers) for the afternoon stream and the per-stream morning/midday ledgers (daily $90 / weekly $450 each).
circuit_breakers.available_buying_power: Never exceed available Robinhood buying power.
circuit_breakers.whitelist_only: Only whitelisted active tickers (config/tickers.json:active) may be traded.
skip_conditions: Skip if the bid/ask spread is too wide.
Skip if the intraday trend cannot be validated down.
Skip a top-up if the current price is not below the prior same-day buy reference price.
Place no more than one strategy order per ticker per stream.

same_day_top_up_policy.summary: One same-day top-up guard governs the morning (10:30), midday (12:30), and afternoon (3:20) live streams AND manual override same-day fills. Each later run buys only the incremental difference max(0, desired_amount - prior_same_day_amount), and only when its current decision price is strictly below the prior same-day reference price; otherwise it buys $0.
same_day_top_up_policy.reference_price_preference: The prior same-day reference price is resolved in order: logged target_price, then decision_price, then average_fill_price (from orders.csv or a manual override's filled_orders.csv). A missing reference price (none available) means NO automatic top-up: the candidate is classified execution_status='manual_review_candidate' (top_up_manual_review=true) at $0.
prior_allocation_chain: Midday (12:30) folds in morning-live and manual same-day fills as prior context.

Afternoon (3:20) folds in morning-live, midday-live, and manual override reruns as prior context (scans /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/morning_dca and /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/midday_dca in addition to its own ce16ba6b task root).
Only scheduled AFTERNOON runs are excluded from prior context; morning/midday-stream scheduled runs remain eligible.
same_day_top_up_policy.final_override_top_up: The final override stream (final manual buy override) applies the same guard: if a ticker was already bought earlier today, it buys only max(0, final_desired_amount - prior_same_day_amount), and only if the final decision price is strictly below the LOWEST prior same-day reference price. A missing prior reference => no auto-top-up.
same_day_top_up_policy.manual_override_handling: Manual override fills recorded under /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/midday_dca/manual_reruns/**/run_state.json and filled_orders.csv, and under /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/manual_runs/final_manual_override_*/ and /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/final_manual_review/** (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true) are EXCLUDED from all scheduled evidence, slippage, reliability, fill counts, watchdog confirmation, and cost basis, and are used ONLY as prior-allocation context for the same-day top-up guard (they affect afternoon 3:20 PM top-up eligibility, no scheduled metric).

jul13_final_manual_override.trigger: User requested final-buy behavior manually after the scheduled 3:20 PM run placed 0 orders; a final manual-review scan ignored trend and applied same-day top-up offsets.
jul13_final_manual_override.note: Manual final-buy overrides and same-day top-up context only; NOT scheduled-afternoon execution evidence. Backfilled under ce16ba6b/manual_runs/final_manual_override_20260713_1536ET/ and midday_dca/manual_reruns/final_manual_override_20260713_1536ET/ with run_type='final_manual_buy_override', valid_afternoon_scheduled_evidence=false, same_day_top_up_context_only=true.

drift_detection_policy.summary: Every live trading run (morning 10:30, midday 12:30, afternoon 3:20) MUST invoke scripts/drift_detection.py against its own run directory immediately AFTER it finishes writing artifacts. The detector reconciles signals.csv (intended auto-buys) against submitted_orders.csv (actual order records) and alerts when any symbol has auto_buy_signal true (case-insensitive true/1/yes) and incremental_order_amount > 0 or a positive desired amount, but no submitted-order record exists for that symbol.
drift_detection_policy.slack_alert: Optional Slack path is OFF unless a webhook is configured. The webhook is read from the DCA_DRIFT_SLACK_WEBHOOK environment variable (or --slack-webhook); it is NEVER hardcoded in config or source. When --slack is set and drift is detected, the detector posts an immediate alert. If no webhook is configured it warns and continues (exit code still reflects drift via --fail-on-drift).
suspected_cause_signals: per-row top_up_guard_result / block_reason / manual_review status (deliberate $0 buy)
drift_detection_policy.jul16_2026_failure_mode: On Thu Jul 16 2026 a live run wrote signals.csv with 8 auto_buy_signal=true rows carrying positive incremental amounts, while submitted_orders.csv was empty and the raw/ directory was missing -- signals computed but no orders placed or persisted, and nothing alerted until the next day. This detector is wired post-artifact-write specifically so that condition pages immediately: it reports drift_detected=true, run_suspected_cause='raw_data_persistence_failure', lists all 8 affected symbols with expected amounts, and (with --slack) fires an immediate Slack alert.

Covers the Jul 16 2026 failure mode (8 auto-buy signals, empty submitted_orders.csv, missing raw/). No secrets: the Slack webhook is read from DCA_DRIFT_SLACK_WEBHOOK, never hardcoded.
